title: Front Door (CDN)
about: Azure Front Door Standard or Premium (the CDN; the classic Azure CDN is retired) in front of an app of the map (a Static Web App, an App Service or a Function App): one global endpoint (<name>.azurefd.net) with HTTPS only, caching and compression if wanted, health probes on the app.

questions.label: Cache what <title> serves (on for a front end's files, off for an API)

requires.question: Which app is <title> in front of?

connection.via: its origin (the app's default host name)

entry.title: <title>
entry.label: <title> (Front Door: <name>.azurefd.net)
entry.role: Front Door in front of <origin>: HTTPS only, health probes; the app stays reachable directly (restrict it to the service tag AzureFrontDoor.Backend and the X-Azure-FDID header by hand)

cost.label: Front Door {name} ({size}): base fee, plus traffic and requests
